metin: Trivial edits like updating button styles or adding a form field drag on for days, leading clients to assume reluctance. Minor Changes Take Days to Deliver Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy Trivial edits like updating button styles or adding a form field drag on for days, leading clients to assume reluctance. The root cause is not developer speed, but the cognitive overhead of deciphering undocumented code. Urgency: Medium · velocity loss · Category: Code Health Field Observations Minor adjustments like adding a menu link or a phone field to a form drag on for weeks. Clients assume deliberate procrastination; in reality, developers spend hours hunting through tangled files just to locate the markup. Observed System Error Signatures Task duration: 2h estimated, 2 days actual delivery Onboarding: how many days for new engineer to boot project? Documentation exists: setup guide, architecture schema, ADRs? Deploy cadence: how many production releases per week? The clearest benchmark is time-to-first-commit for a new developer. If local onboarding takes longer than one day, velocity loss stems from developer experience, not individual talent. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Zero developer documentation Domain knowledge exists solely in individuals' memories. Every change requires historical code archaeology. Differential test: Can a new dev boot the project locally within 1 day? Evidence: Missing README / architecture docs → A Resolution: Write README setup + architecture decision records Common anti-pattern fix: Blindly grepping across repositories without architectural documentation leads to editing the wrong component overrides, wasting hours of engineering time. B · Manual deployment ceremony Deployments rely on manual FTP / SSH commands; tiny tweaks require extensive manual rituals. Differential test: Is deployment automated with a single command? Evidence: Manual FTP/SSH release steps → B Resolution: Automate CI/CD · one-click release pipeline Common anti-pattern fix: Overwriting live files via FTP skips version control and automated linting, turning a single misplaced character into an instant site outage. C · Unstructured spaghetti architecture Locating which file controls the feature takes hours; scattered business logic and inconsistent naming conventions. Differential test: Does locating target logic require hours of grep searching? Evidence: Hours spent locating source code file → C Resolution: Apply Scout Rule: clean up target module gradually Common anti-pattern fix: Stacking !important rules in CSS to force styles temporarily overrides layout issues while making subsequent UI maintenance virtually impossible. Who resolves it None of these are resolved by 'working overtime'. The payoff is not immediate; it builds up: the same team ships noticeably more work in the same time. Impact If Left Unresolved Sluggish delivery erodes client relationships. Clients interpret delays as neglect, while engineers burn out operating in an unmaintained codebase. PayTR payment frame won't open, or the payment stays 'In Progress'. Token signature, the 'OK' reply, duplicate notifications: the tests and the fixes. PayTR Token Error and 'In Progress' Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy The PayTR payment frame will not open, or the customer pays but the transaction stays 'In Progress' in the PayTR panel. There are two separate breaks: in the token request before payment, or at the notification URL after payment. PayTR's own response tells you which. Urgency: Critical · checkout halted · Category: Orders & Payments Field Observations Instead of the payment frame, the checkout page shows an empty area or an error message. Or the payment goes through and the customer receives the bank's confirmation, but the order is never confirmed on the site. On the Transactions page of the PayTR merchant panel, the same payment waits as 'In Progress'. What you see on screen Transactions › In Progress PayTR merchant panel — payment taken, no 'OK' reply to the notification get-token response: status ≠ success · reason: … Token request response — the payment frame never opens Observed System Error Signatures get-token response: status is not success, reason field is filled → A · Token request rejected Transactions page: payment taken, status 'In Progress' → B · No 'OK' to the notification Notification URL access log: the same merchant_oid arrives every minute → B · No 'OK' to the notification Stock reduced twice and two confirmation emails for one merchant_oid → C · Notification processed twice With debug_on=1 added to the token request during integration, PayTR spells out the cause of the error. Either way, the cause is in the reason field of the response; look there first. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Token request rejected The get-token request made before payment fails. The most common cause is a paytr_token signature not built in the documented order: field order, the amount not multiplied by 100, the basket not base64-encoded, or test_mode left out of the signature. Differential test: Does get-token return a filled reason field? Evidence: reason field filled in the response → A Resolution: Fix signature order and amount Common anti-pattern fix: debug_on is switched off so the error disappears from view; the payment frame still does not open, but now the cause is hidden too. B · No 'OK' to the notification The payment was taken and PayTR sent the result to the notification URL, but the reply is not the plain text 'OK'. According to PayTR's documentation the notification then counts as failed, is retried a minute later, and the transaction stays 'In Progress' in the panel. An HTML page, an error page or a redirect also means PayTR did not get 'OK'. Differential test: Is the same notification sent every minute? Evidence: Same notification arrives every minute → B Resolution: Reply with plain text 'OK' only Common anti-pattern fix: Orders are confirmed by hand from the PayTR panel; since the notification URL is never fixed, the same chore repeats with every payment and missed orders are never fulfilled. C · Notification processed twice PayTR may send more than one notification for the same payment. The documentation says only the first should be acted on and repeats should simply get 'OK'. Without this check the same order is confirmed twice: stock drops twice and the customer gets two emails. Differential test: Was the same merchant_oid processed twice? Evidence: Same merchant_oid processed twice → C Resolution: Act on the first, 'OK' the repeats Common anti-pattern fix: To block repeats, the notification URL returns an error to the second notification; PayTR counts that as a failed notification and keeps retrying. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes In the PayTR merchant panel, check the status of the affected payment on the Transactions page. 'In Progress' means the payment was taken and the notification was never completed. If the payment frame does not open, repeat the token request in your integration environment with debug_on=1 and read the reason field of the response. Check that the notification URL points to the right address and does not redirect. In the server access logs, look at requests to the notification URL and the replies sent. If the same merchant_oid arrives every minute, the reply is not 'OK'. Check orders for two records, two stock reductions or two confirmation emails with the same merchant_oid. When to hand it over Hand it over if the signature calculation or the notification reply has to change in code, or if 'In Progress' payments must be matched to orders in bulk. Trial and error in live payment code creates new duplicate transactions. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows payment integrations. The lasting fix has three parts: building the signature in the documented order, a notification URL that verifies the incoming hash and replies with plain 'OK' only, and never processing the same merchant_oid twice. Impact If Left Unresolved Every 'In Progress' transaction is a customer who has paid but whose order was never confirmed. If the break is on the token side, payment never starts; the cart is abandoned and the loss shows up in no panel at all. A generic error after returning from bank verification. mdStatus, the 3DS completion request and a lost session: the test that tells them apart, and the fix. iyzico 3D Secure Return Error Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy The customer entered the code on the bank's verification screen and, back on the site, hit a generic message such as 'system error' or 'an unexpected error occurred', sometimes with an emptied cart. The real reason behind the generic message is in the values iyzico sends back on return and in the response to the payment completion request. Urgency: Critical · checkout halted · Category: Orders & Payments Field Observations The error appears the moment the customer returns from the bank screen to the site. They do not know whether the payment went through and try again; support gets the question 'was I charged?'. The on-screen message is the same in every case, so it says nothing about the cause. What you see on screen errorCode 1 / 2: system error iyzico error codes 1 and 2 — official error code list CALLBACK_3DS / INIT_3DS: error during 3D Secure verification iyzico error codes CALLBACK_3DS and INIT_3DS errorCode 5014: conversation data could not be decrypted during 3D Secure iyzico error code 5014 Observed System Error Signatures Return request (callbackUrl): status=failure, mdStatus is not 1 → A · Bank verification failed Return arrived but the 3DS completion request was never sent → B · Payment not completed 3DS completion response: errorCode and errorMessage are filled → B · Payment not completed No session on return: cart is empty, the user appears logged out → C · Session lost on return On return, iyzico posts status, paymentId, conversationId, conversationData and mdStatus. Logging these five values at the return URL shows at a glance which step sits behind the generic error message. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Bank verification failed If mdStatus is not 1 on return, the cardholder or the bank did not complete verification. iyzico's documentation lists what each value means: for example 0 is an invalid verification, 5 means verification could not be performed, 7 is a system error. This is not a bug in the site's code; the customer needs to see the right message. Differential test: Is mdStatus anything other than 1? Evidence: mdStatus is not 1 → A Resolution: Show a clear message Common anti-pattern fix: The payment code gets changed when the error shows up; but the problem is with the card or the bank, the change breaks a working flow, and the customer still sees a generic message. B · Payment not completed Verification came back successful, but the site did not send the 3DS completion request, or sent it incomplete. According to iyzico's documentation the payment is finalised by this request, and if conversationData came back on return it must be included. The errorCode and errorMessage in the completion response tell you which step failed. Differential test: mdStatus is 1 but completion call missing or failed? Evidence: Return present, completion missing or failed → B Resolution: Send completion with conversationData Common anti-pattern fix: The order is confirmed as soon as verification succeeds on return; with the completion request skipped, the payment is never finalised and the order is fulfilled without being paid. C · Session lost on return The return from the bank screen to the site is a form submission (POST) coming from another site. Browsers do not send cookies marked SameSite=Lax with such requests. If the session cookie uses this setting, the site does not recognise the user or the cart on return, and the order cannot be matched. Differential test: Cart empty and session gone on return? Evidence: No session and empty cart on return → C Resolution: Match the order by ID, not by session Common anti-pattern fix: When no session is found, the customer is redirected to the login page; the payment data posted on return is lost in that redirect and the order is never matched. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes Find the status and mdStatus values posted to the return URL in your logs. If mdStatus is not 1, the problem is with the card or the bank, not the code. If mdStatus is 1, check whether the 3DS completion request was sent, and read the errorCode and errorMessage in its response. Look the errorCode up in iyzico's official error code list; rely on that code, not on the generic on-screen message. If the cart empties on return, check the SameSite setting of the session cookie in the browser's developer tools. Check the iyzico panel for a payment record belonging to the same order. If there is one, do not ask the customer to pay again before the order is matched to it. When to hand it over Hand it over if the 3DS completion request or the return URL code has to change, if a cookie setting will affect live sessions, or if there are customers with a payment record but no order. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows payment integrations. The return URL has to log the incoming values, show a meaningful message based on mdStatus, send the 3DS completion request in full, and match the order by ID rather than by session. Impact If Left Unresolved Customers retry or give up without knowing whether they were charged. Because the generic message hides where the problem is, the same loss repeats every day and is noticed only when complaints arrive. Kanıt: Bildirim adresine 403 / 503 → A Çözüm: Adresi güvenlik kuralından çıkar Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Siparişler her gün sağlayıcı paneline bakılarak elle onaylanır; engel yerinde kaldığı için yoğun günlerde gözden kaçan siparişler kendiliğinden iptal olur. WooCommerce bu tür ölümcül hataları fatal-errors kaydına yazar; sipariş güncellenmeden kalır. Ayırt edici test: fatal-errors kaydında ödeme eklentisi var mı? Son günlerde bir güvenlik eklentisi, güvenlik duvarı kuralı ya da bakım modu değişti mi kontrol edin. Ne zaman devretmeli? Çözülmezse ne olur WooCommerce, ayarlanan süre dolunca «Ödeme bekliyor»daki siparişleri kendiliğinden iptal eder ve stoğu geri açar. Paid at the provider, but the WooCommerce order stays 'Pending payment' or 'On hold'. Blocked notification, plugin error or approval step: tests and fixes. WooCommerce: Paid but Order Pending Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy The payment provider shows a successful payment, but in WooCommerce the order stays 'Pending payment' or 'On hold'. The order is not fulfilled and may cancel itself after a while. The problem is usually in the step where the payment result is written to the order. Urgency: Critical · commercial loss · Category: Orders & Payments Field Observations The customer says they have paid, and the iyzico or PayTR panel shows a successful transaction. In WooCommerce › Orders, the same order sits with the 'Pending payment' or 'On hold' label. Depending on stock settings, a 'Pending payment' order is cancelled after a while and its stock released. What you see on screen Pending payment WooCommerce order status — official definition: order received, no payment made On hold WooCommerce order status — official definition: awaiting payment confirmation, stock reduced Observed System Error Signatures Provider panel: payment successful · WooCommerce: 'Pending payment' → A · Notification blocked Access log: 403 / 503 on the notification URL ending in ?wc-api= → A · Notification blocked Payment plugin error in the fatal-errors log → B · Plugin error Order note: status set to 'On hold' by the plugin → C · Put on hold on purpose WooCommerce writes every status change to the order notes. The notes show at a glance whether the status never changed or a plugin changed it on purpose. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Notification blocked The URL where the payment provider reports the result is blocked by a security plugin, a firewall or maintenance mode. In WooCommerce, payment plugins' notification URLs usually end in ?wc-api=. The notification never reaches the order, so the status never changes. Differential test: Does the callback URL return 403 / 503? Evidence: 403 / 503 on the notification URL → A Resolution: Exempt the URL from the firewall Common anti-pattern fix: Orders are confirmed by hand every day from the provider panel; the block stays in place, so on busy days missed orders cancel themselves. B · Plugin error The URL is reachable, but the payment plugin fails while handling the notification: a PHP error, a signature that fails verification, or an amount or order-number mismatch. WooCommerce writes such fatal errors to the fatal-errors log; the order stays unchanged. Differential test: Is the payment plugin in the fatal-errors log? Evidence: Plugin error in fatal-errors log → B Resolution: Fix the error, reprocess the notification Common anti-pattern fix: The plugin is updated or rolled back without reading the error log; if the cause is a signature or amount mismatch, changing versions does not fix it. C · Put on hold on purpose By WooCommerce's definition, 'On hold' means payment confirmation is awaited: stock has been reduced but the payment is not yet confirmed. Some payment methods and plugin settings put orders into this status on purpose. In that case the issue is the approval process, not the code. Differential test: Do order notes show the plugin set the status? Evidence: Status changed by the plugin → C Resolution: Clarify the approval step Common anti-pattern fix: The plugin setting is changed blindly and orders are confirmed directly; orders get fulfilled before the payment is actually verified. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes Open the affected order's notes: did the status never change, or did a plugin change it? Find the payment record and the notification attempts for the same order in the payment provider's panel. In the server access logs, check the requests to the notification URL (in most plugins, the URL ending in ?wc-api=) and the status codes returned. In WooCommerce › Status › Logs, check the fatal-errors log and the payment plugin's own log. Check whether a security plugin, a firewall rule or maintenance mode changed in the last few days. When to hand it over Hand it over if plugin code or a security rule has to change on the live site, if paid orders in 'Pending payment' must be matched in bulk, or if orders have started cancelling themselves. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows WordPress and the payment plugin. The notification URL must get through the security layers, the plugin error must be found in the logs and fixed, and paid orders stuck in 'Pending payment' must be matched to the provider's records. Impact If Left Unresolved When the configured time runs out, WooCommerce cancels 'Pending payment' orders on its own and releases their stock. A paid order is silently cancelled this way; while the customer waits for their product, the stock is sold to someone else. Üç olası neden ve ayırt edici testleri A · Hız sınırı aşıldı Pazaryerleri dakikalık istek sınırı uygular. Hepsiburada dokümanına göre bir satıcı için dakikada ortalama 240 istek atılabilir, aşılırsa 429 döner. Trendyol sınırları servis grubu bazında tanımlar; sınır dolunca aynı dakika içinde o gruba yeni istek gönderilemez. Toplu stok ve fiyat işleri aynı anda başlatılınca sınır dakikalar içinde dolar. Ayırt edici test: Yanıtlar toplu işlerde mi 429'a dönüyor? Kanıt: Yoğun işlerde 429 → A Çözüm: İstekleri sınıra göre kuyruğa al Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: 429 alınınca istekler beklemeden hemen yeniden gönderilir; tekrar denemeler sınırı daha da doldurur ve kuyruk hiç boşalmaz. B · Kimlik bilgisi değişti Trendyol, hatalı yetkilendirmede 401 ve ClientApiAuthenticationException döndürür; bilgiler satıcı panelindeki Entegrasyon Bilgileri sayfasından alınır. Hepsiburada'da satıcı panelinden yeni servis anahtarı oluşturulduğunda, dokümana göre yeni anahtarın entegratör ekranlarında da güncellenmesi gerekir. Hepsiburada ayrıca servislerinin kimlik doğrulama yapısını değiştirdiğini duyurmuştur. Ayırt edici test: 401, bir anahtar değişikliğinden sonra mı başladı? Kanıt: Anahtar değişikliğinden sonra 401 → B Çözüm: Yeni anahtarı entegrasyona gir Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: 401 alınınca satıcı panelinden bir yeni anahtar daha üretilir ama entegrasyona girilmez; sorun anahtarda değil, anahtarın entegrasyonda güncellenmemesindedir ve hata sürer. C · User-Agent eksik Trendyol her istekte User-Agent başlığı ister: kendi yazdığınız entegrasyonda «Satıcı Id - SelfIntegration», bir entegratör kullanıyorsanız «Satıcı Id - Entegrasyon Firması İsmi». Dokümana göre User-Agent bilgisi olmayan istekler 403 hatasıyla engellenir. Sunucu, kütüphane ya da vekil sunucu değişikliği bu başlığı sessizce düşürebilir. Ayırt edici test: İstek başlığında User-Agent var mı? Kanıt: Başlıkta User-Agent yok, yanıt 403 → C Çözüm: Başlığı doğru biçimde gönder Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: 403 bir yetki hatası sanılıp API bilgileri değiştirilir; asıl eksik olan istek başlığıdır ve yeni bilgilerle de 403 sürer. İlk 10 dakikada kendiniz kontrol edin Entegrasyonun kayıtlarında son saatlerdeki isteklerin HTTP kodlarını sayın: 429 mu, 401 mi, 403 mü? 429 varsa bunların hangi işle (toplu stok, fiyat, sipariş çekme) ve hangi saatte başladığına bakın. 401 varsa satıcı panelinde (Trendyol: Hesap Bilgilerim › Entegrasyon Bilgileri; Hepsiburada: Bilgilerim › Entegrasyon) bilgilerin ya da servis anahtarının yakın zamanda değişip değişmediğini kontrol edin. 403 varsa Trendyol'a giden isteklerde User-Agent başlığının bulunduğunu ve «Satıcı Id - …» biçiminde olduğunu kontrol edin. Kim çözer Pazaryeri entegrasyonunu bilen backend mühendisi. İsteklerin sınıra göre kuyruğa alınması, kimlik bilgisi değişikliklerinin entegrasyona yansıtılması, User-Agent başlığının doğru biçimde gönderilmesi ve her isteğin HTTP kodunun kaydedilmesi gerekir. Trendyol or Hepsiburada integration returning 429, 401 or 403. Rate limit, a changed service key or a missing User-Agent: the tests that tell them apart. Trendyol & Hepsiburada API: 429, 401 Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy The Trendyol or Hepsiburada integration suddenly starts returning 429, 401 or 403; stock, price and order sync stop. The three codes have three separate causes: the rate limit, the credentials and the request header. Each marketplace's own documentation defines them. Urgency: High · data sync halted · Category: Contact & Integrations Field Observations Stock and prices stop updating in the store panel, and new orders do not reach the central system. The integration's own screen either just says 'failed' or shows no warning at all; the real information is in the HTTP code the marketplace returns. What you see on screen HTTP 429 Too Many Requests Rate limit exceeded — Hepsiburada: about 240 requests per minute; Trendyol: per-minute limits by service group 401 · ClientApiAuthenticationException Trendyol — failed authorization 401 Unauthorized: password entered incorrectly Hepsiburada — wrong credentials 403 Trendyol — requests without a User-Agent header are blocked Observed System Error Signatures After the bulk stock job starts, responses turn to 429 → A · Rate limit exceeded The service key was renewed and 401 began the same day → B · Credentials changed Trendyol response: 401 ClientApiAuthenticationException → B · Credentials changed No User-Agent in the request headers, response 403 → C · User-Agent missing 429, 401 and 403 all show up as 'failed' on the same screen, but they say three different things. Keeping the HTTP code and time of every request in the integration's logs separates the cause at a glance. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Rate limit exceeded Marketplaces apply per-minute request limits. According to Hepsiburada's documentation, a seller can send about 240 requests per minute, and exceeding that returns 429. Trendyol defines limits by service group; once a group's limit is reached, no new request to that group can be sent within the same minute. When bulk stock and price jobs start at the same time, the limit fills up within minutes. Differential test: Do responses turn to 429 during bulk jobs? Evidence: 429 during bulk jobs → A Resolution: Queue requests within the limit Common anti-pattern fix: Requests are resent immediately after a 429 without waiting; the retries fill the limit further and the queue never drains. B · Credentials changed Trendyol returns 401 with ClientApiAuthenticationException on failed authorization; the credentials come from the Integration Information page in the seller panel. On Hepsiburada, when a new service key is created in the seller panel, the documentation says it must also be updated in the integrator's screens. Hepsiburada has also announced a change to the authentication structure of its services. Differential test: Did 401 start after a key change? Evidence: 401 after a key change → B Resolution: Enter the new key in the integration Common anti-pattern fix: After a 401, yet another new key is generated in the seller panel but never entered into the integration; the problem is not the key but that it was not updated in the integration, so the error continues. C · User-Agent missing Trendyol requires a User-Agent header on every request: 'Seller Id - SelfIntegration' for an integration you built yourself, or 'Seller Id - Integrator Company Name' if you use an integrator. According to the documentation, requests without a User-Agent are blocked with a 403 error. A server, library or proxy change can silently drop this header. Differential test: Is there a User-Agent header? Evidence: No User-Agent header, response 403 → C Resolution: Send the header in the right format Common anti-pattern fix: The 403 is taken for a permissions error and the API credentials are changed; what is actually missing is the request header, so the 403 continues with the new credentials too. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes Count the HTTP codes of the requests in the integration's logs for the last few hours: is it 429, 401 or 403? If there are 429s, check which job (bulk stock, price, order pull) they started with and at what time. If there are 401s, check in the seller panel (Trendyol: Integration Information; Hepsiburada: the Integration page) whether the credentials or the service key changed recently. If there are 403s, check that requests to Trendyol carry a User-Agent header in the 'Seller Id - ...' format. If you use a ready-made integrator, ask them whether the problem affects all of their stores or only yours. When to hand it over Hand it over if the request queue or retry logic has to change in code, if the stock, price and order gaps built up while the integration was down must be fixed in bulk, or if the integration must be moved to Hepsiburada's new authentication structure. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows marketplace integrations. Requests must be queued within the limit, credential changes must reach the integration, the User-Agent header must be sent in the right format, and the HTTP code of every request must be logged. Impact If Left Unresolved As long as stock and price are not updated, the marketplace keeps selling on stale data: out-of-stock items are sold, or items are sold at the wrong price. Since orders are not pulled, dispatch deadlines are missed. Official documentation → Trendyol — 2. Authorization (API key, User-Agent; in Turkish) → Trendyol — 1. Son ürün hem Trendyol'da hem Hepsiburada'da satıldı. Reddedilen stok güncellemesi, geciken senkron ve eşleşmeyen sipariş: ayırt edici test ve çözüm yolu. Aynı ürün iki pazaryerinde satıldı Ana Sayfa Hizmetler ve Çalışma Modeli Kapasite & Altyapı Ajans Kiti Crash Test (60sn) Devir Kontrolü tmai Teşhis Kataloğu Kurtarılabilirlik İndeksi Post-Mortem ve Kök Neden Arşivi Triyaj Simülatörü SLA & Taahhütler Teknoloji Matrisi Gizlilik Sözleşmesi Gizlilik ve Çalışma Sözleşmesi Hasar Simülatörü SWAT Radarı Kod Sağlığı Kurtarma mı, Sıfırdan Yazım mı? Kesinti Maliyeti Teknik Sözlük Hikayemiz Acil Teknik Destek Hakkımızda KVKK & Gizlilik Son kalan ürün aynı gün hem Trendyol'da hem Hepsiburada'da, ya da hem pazaryerinde hem sitede satıldı. Siparişlerden birini iptal etmek zorundasınız. Stok bir kanalda düşmüş ama öbür kanala hiç ulaşmamış ya da geç ulaşmış. Aciliyet: Kritik · ticari kayıp · Kategori: Sipariş & Ödeme Sahada nasıl görünür İki kanaldan aynı ürün için sipariş gelir, depoda tek adet vardır. Merkezi stok sistemi sıfırı gösterir ama pazaryeri panelinde ürün hâlâ stokta görünür. Genellikle kampanya günlerinde ve toplu stok güncellemesinden hemen sonra ortaya çıkar. Ekranda gördüğünüz metin status: FAILED · failureReasons: […] Trendyol toplu işlem kontrolü — istek kabul edildi ama ürün güncellenmedi ListingFrozen Hepsiburada — kilitli listing için güncelleme yapılamaz MismatchingSkusSpecified Hepsiburada — HBSku ile MerchantSku yanlış eşleştirilmiş Sisteminizde bu satırları görüyorsanız Toplu işlem sonucu: ürün satırında status FAILED → A · Gönderildi sanıldı, reddedildi Stok güncellemesi yanıtı yalnız işlem numarası, sonuç hiç sorgulanmamış → A · Gönderildi sanıldı, reddedildi Diğer kanalın stoğu siparişten dakikalar sonra düşmüş → B · Güncelleme geç ulaştı Pazaryerindeki sipariş merkezi stok sisteminde yok → C · Sipariş ya da ürün eşleşmedi Pazaryerleri stok güncellemesini hemen değil, sırayla işler; istek kabul edildiğinde yalnız bir işlem numarası döner. Asıl sonuç, o numarayla sorgulanan işlem kontrolündedir. Üç olası neden ve ayırt edici testleri A · Gönderildi sanıldı, reddedildi Trendyol stok ve fiyat isteği kabul edildiğinde yalnız bir batchRequestId döndürür; ürün bazındaki sonuç toplu işlem kontrolü servisinden okunur ve tek tek ürünler başarısız olabilir. Hepsiburada da bir işlem numarası (Inventory Upload Id) döndürür; satır bazındaki hatalar ayrı bir kontrol servisinde görünür. Sonuç sorgulanmazsa reddedilen güncelleme fark edilmez. Ayırt edici test: Toplu işlem sonucunda FAILED satır var mı? Kanıt: Toplu işlem sonucunda FAILED satır → A Çözüm: Sonucu sorgula, hatayı düzelt Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Aynı stok isteği hemen tekrar gönderilir; Trendyol dokümanına göre aynı istek 15 dakika boyunca tekrarlı gönderilemez, tekrar da reddedilir. B · Güncelleme geç ulaştı Stok senkronu belirli aralıklarla ya da bir kuyruktan çalışır. Hız sınırı dolduğunda ya da Hepsiburada'da aynı anda en fazla beş bekleyen işlem sınırına takıldığında kuyruk birikir. Siparişle diğer kanalın stoğunun düşmesi arasındaki sürede son ürün iki kanalda birden satılabilir. Ayırt edici test: Sipariş ile stok düşümü arasında dakikalar mı var? Kanıt: Sipariş ile stok düşümü arasında dakikalar → B Çözüm: Siparişte stoğu hemen düş, sonra kanallara yay Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Senkron sıklığı artırılır; istek sayısı hız sınırını daha çabuk doldurur ve gecikme azalmak yerine artar. C · Sipariş ya da ürün eşleşmedi Pazaryerindeki sipariş merkezi sisteme hiç çekilmemiş ya da ürün yanlış kayıtla eşleşmiş. Sipariş çekme sınırları, sayfalama ya da sorgu aralığı yüzünden atlanan bir sipariş stoğu düşürmez. Hepsiburada'da HBSku ile MerchantSku yanlış eşleştiğinde güncelleme MismatchingSkusSpecified hatasıyla reddedilir. Ayırt edici test: Sipariş pazaryerinde var, merkezde yok mu? Kanıt: Sipariş pazaryerinde var, merkezde yok → C Çözüm: Sipariş çekmeyi ve ürün eşlemesini düzelt Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Eksik sipariş elle girilir ama sipariş çekme mantığı düzeltilmez; bir sonraki yoğun günde atlanan siparişler yine birikir. İlk 10 dakikada kendiniz kontrol edin Çift satılan ürün için iki siparişin saatlerini ve merkezi sistemde stoğun düştüğü anı karşılaştırın. O saatlerdeki stok güncellemelerinin sonucunu sorgulayın: Trendyol'da toplu işlem kontrolü, Hepsiburada'da listing güncelleme işlem kontrolü. Sonuçta FAILED ya da hata satırı varsa sebebini (failureReasons, hata adı) not edin. Son birkaç günün pazaryeri siparişlerini sayıp hepsinin merkezi sisteme düştüğünü kontrol edin. Ürünün pazaryerindeki kimliğinin (barkod, HBSku, MerchantSku) merkezi sistemdeki kayıtla aynı olup olmadığına bakın. Ne zaman devretmeli? Stok düşme mantığı ya da senkron kuyruğu değiştirilecekse, geçmiş çift satışlar ve stok farkları toplu düzeltilecekse ya da ürün eşlemesi toplu olarak yeniden kurulacaksa devredin. Kim çözer Pazaryeri entegrasyonunu bilen backend mühendisi. Stok siparişte tek bir merkezde düşürülmeli ve kanallara oradan gönderilmeli; her güncellemenin sonucu sorgulanmalı ve sipariş çekimi kaldığı yerden devam etmelidir. Çözülmezse ne olur Her çift satış, iptal edilecek bir sipariş ve hayal kırıklığına uğrayan bir müşteri demektir. Kampanya günlerinde sipariş hızı arttıkça aynı ürün için çift satış sayısı da artar. baslik: Same Item Sold on Two Marketplaces
metin: The last unit sold on both Trendyol and Hepsiburada. A rejected stock update, a late sync or an unmatched order: the test that tells them apart, and the fix. Same Item Sold on Two Marketplaces Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy The last unit was sold on the same day on both Trendyol and Hepsiburada, or on both a marketplace and the site. One of the orders has to be cancelled. Stock dropped in one channel but never reached the other channel, or reached it late. Urgency: Critical · revenue loss · Category: Orders & Payments Field Observations Orders for the same item arrive from two channels, and there is one unit in the warehouse. The central stock system shows zero, but the marketplace panel still shows the item in stock. It usually appears on campaign days and right after a bulk stock update. What you see on screen status: FAILED · failureReasons: […] Trendyol batch result check — the request was accepted but the item was not updated ListingFrozen Hepsiburada — a locked listing cannot be updated MismatchingSkusSpecified Hepsiburada — HBSku and MerchantSku are mismatched Observed System Error Signatures Batch result: status FAILED on the item row → A · Assumed sent, actually rejected Stock update response is only an operation ID, the result was never queried → A · Assumed sent, actually rejected Stock on the other channel dropped minutes after the order → B · Update arrived late The marketplace order is not in the central stock system → C · Order or item not matched Marketplaces process stock updates in a queue, not immediately; when the request is accepted, only an operation ID comes back. The real result is in the status check queried with that ID. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Assumed sent, actually rejected When a Trendyol stock and price request is accepted, only a batchRequestId comes back; the per-item result is read from the batch result service, and individual items can fail. Hepsiburada also returns an operation ID (Inventory Upload Id); row-level errors appear in a separate status service. If the result is never queried, the rejected update goes unnoticed. Differential test: Any FAILED rows in the batch result? Evidence: FAILED rows in the batch result → A Resolution: Check results, fix the rejects Common anti-pattern fix: The same stock request is resent immediately; according to Trendyol's documentation the same request cannot be sent repeatedly for 15 minutes, so the retry is rejected too. B · Update arrived late Stock sync runs at intervals or from a queue. When the rate limit fills up, or when Hepsiburada's limit of at most five pending operations at a time is reached, the queue backs up. In the time between the order and the stock drop on the other channel, the last unit can be sold on both channels. Differential test: Minutes between order and stock drop? Evidence: Minutes between order and stock drop → B Resolution: Reserve at order, then push to channels Common anti-pattern fix: The sync frequency is increased; the request count fills the rate limit faster, and the delay grows instead of shrinking. C · Order or item not matched The marketplace order was never pulled into the central system, or the item is matched to the wrong record. An order skipped because of order pull limits, pagination or the query window does not reduce stock. On Hepsiburada, when HBSku and MerchantSku are mismatched, the update is rejected with MismatchingSkusSpecified. Differential test: Order on the marketplace but not in center? Evidence: Order on the marketplace, not in the center → C Resolution: Fix order pulls and item mapping Common anti-pattern fix: The missing order is entered by hand, but the order pull logic is not fixed; on the next busy day, skipped orders pile up again. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes For the double-sold item, compare the times of the two orders with the moment stock dropped in the central system. Query the results of the stock updates made around those times: the batch result check on Trendyol, the listing update status check on Hepsiburada. If the result has FAILED or error rows, note the reason (failureReasons, error name). Count the marketplace orders of the last few days and check that all of them reached the central system. Check whether the item's marketplace identifiers (barcode, HBSku, MerchantSku) match the record in the central system. When to hand it over Hand it over if the stock reduction logic or the sync queue has to change, if past double sales and stock gaps must be fixed in bulk, or if item mapping must be rebuilt in bulk. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows marketplace integrations. Stock must be reduced in one central place at order time and pushed to the channels from there; the result of every update must be checked, and order pulls must resume from where they stopped. Impact If Left Unresolved Every double sale means an order to cancel and a disappointed customer. On campaign days, as the order rate goes up, so does the number of double sales of the same item. Kopan bağlantı, eksik alıcı bilgisi ve yanlış fatura türü: test ve çözüm. e-Arşiv fatura siteden kesilmiyor Ana Sayfa Hizmetler ve Çalışma Modeli Kapasite & Altyapı Ajans Kiti Crash Test (60sn) Devir Kontrolü tmai Teşhis Kataloğu Kurtarılabilirlik İndeksi Post-Mortem ve Kök Neden Arşivi Triyaj Simülatörü SLA & Taahhütler Teknoloji Matrisi Gizlilik Sözleşmesi Gizlilik ve Çalışma Sözleşmesi Hasar Simülatörü SWAT Radarı Kod Sağlığı Kurtarma mı, Sıfırdan Yazım mı? Kesinti Maliyeti Teknik Sözlük Hikayemiz Acil Teknik Destek Hakkımızda KVKK & Gizlilik Siparişler tamamlanıyor ama e-Arşiv faturaları oluşmuyor, eksik oluşuyor ya da entegratör tarafından reddediliyor. Fatura, siparişten entegratöre giden bağlantının bir halkasında düşüyor; hangi halkada düştüğünü entegratörün yanıtı ve sipariş kaydı birlikte söyler. Aciliyet: Yüksek · yasal yükümlülük · Kategori: Sipariş & Ödeme Sahada nasıl görünür Müşteri faturasının e-postaya gelmediğini söyler ya da mali müşavir ay sonunda siparişlerle faturaların tutmadığını fark eder. Sitede sipariş «tamamlandı» görünür, entegratör panelinde ise o siparişe ait fatura yoktur ya da «reddedildi» durumundadır. Ekranda gördüğünüz metin Entegratör paneli: fatura yok · ya da «reddedildi» Özel entegratörün paneli — hata kodları ve metinleri entegratöre göre değişir Sisteminizde bu satırları görüyorsanız Entegratör paneli: sipariş numarasına ait fatura kaydı yok → A · Bağlantı koptu Uygulama kaydı: entegratör isteği 401 ya da zaman aşımı → A · Bağlantı koptu Entegratör yanıtı: ret · alıcı VKN/TCKN ya da adres hatalı → B · Entegratör reddetti Alıcı VKN'si e-Fatura kayıtlı kullanıcı, fatura e-Arşiv gönderilmiş → C · Yanlış fatura türü Faturayı entegratör düzenler ve Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı'na iletir; sitenin görevi doğru veriyi bir kez göndermek ve yanıtı kaydetmektir. Entegratörün ret yanıtı kaydedilmiyorsa sorun görünmez kalır. Üç olası neden ve ayırt edici testleri A · Bağlantı koptu Siteden entegratöre giden istek hiç gitmiyor ya da yolda düşüyor: kimlik bilgisi değişmiş, erişim anahtarının süresi dolmuş, entegratörün adresi değişmiş ya da istek zaman aşımına uğruyor. Entegratör panelinde o siparişe ait hiçbir kayıt yoktur. Ayırt edici test: Entegratörde siparişe ait kayıt var mı? Kanıt: Entegratörde kayıt yok, uygulamada 401 → A Çözüm: Kimlik ve adresi düzelt, kuyruğa al Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Faturasız siparişler entegratör panelinden tek tek elle faturalanır ama bağlantı düzeltilmez; ertesi gün aynı liste yeniden oluşur. B · Entegratör reddetti İstek entegratöre ulaşıyor ama fatura verisi eksik ya da hatalı olduğu için reddediliyor: alıcının VKN ya da TCKN'si, adresi, vergi oranı ya da tutar alanları. Ret yanıtı kaydedilmiyorsa site faturanın kesildiğini sanar. Ayırt edici test: Entegratör yanıtında ret var mı? Kanıt: Entegratör yanıtında ret ve hata kodu → B Çözüm: Veriyi düzelt, bir kez gönder Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Reddedilen fatura aynı veriyle yeniden gönderilir; veri düzelmediği için yine reddedilir, ya da düzeltme sırasında aynı sipariş için iki fatura oluşur. C · Yanlış fatura türü Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı'na göre e-Arşiv fatura, e-Fatura sistemine kayıtlı olmayan mükelleflere ve mükellef olmayanlara yapılan satışlarda düzenlenir. Alıcı e-Fatura sistemine kayıtlıysa fatura e-Fatura olarak düzenlenmelidir. Site kurumsal alıcının kayıtlı olup olmadığını kontrol etmeden e-Arşiv gönderirse fatura yanlış türde düzenlenir ya da entegratör tarafından reddedilir. Ayırt edici test: Alıcı e-Fatura sistemine kayıtlı mı? Kanıt: Alıcı e-Fatura kayıtlı, e-Arşiv gitmiş → C Çözüm: Alıcıya göre türü seç Sık yapılan yanlış düzeltme: Fatura türü kodda sabit bırakılıp yalnız reddedilen siparişler elle düzeltilir; kurumsal alıcıdan gelen her yeni siparişte aynı durum tekrarlanır. İlk 10 dakikada kendiniz kontrol edin Entegratör panelinde son faturaları listeleyin, siparişlerle karşılaştırıp hangi siparişlerin faturasız kaldığını bulun. Faturasız siparişler için uygulama kayıtlarında entegratöre giden isteği ve dönen yanıtı arayın: hiç istek yoksa sorun bağlantıda, ret varsa veride. Ret yanıtlarındaki hata kodunu entegratörün kendi dokümanında arayın. Kurumsal (VKN'li) alıcılarda, alıcının Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı'nın e-Fatura kayıtlı kullanıcılar listesinde olup olmadığını kontrol edin. Entegratör kullanıcı bilgisi ya da erişim anahtarı son günlerde değişti mi, sözleşme ya da kullanım hakkı bitti mi kontrol edin. Ne zaman devretmeli? Faturayı oluşturan kod değiştirilecekse, faturasız kalmış siparişler toplu faturalandırılacaksa ya da fatura türü ve vergi alanlarıyla ilgili bir karar gerekiyorsa devredin. Vergi ve mevzuat kararı mali müşavirindir; teknik ekip yalnız bağlantıyı onarır. Kim çözer Entegrasyonu bilen backend mühendisi ile mali müşavir birlikte. Mühendis bağlantıyı, ret yanıtlarının kaydedilmesini ve eksik faturaların bir kez yeniden gönderilmesini onarır; fatura türü ve vergi alanlarıyla ilgili kararlar mali müşavirindir. Çözülmezse ne olur Satılan malın faturası zamanında düzenlenmezse sorun teknik olmaktan çıkar, yasal bir yükümlülük olur. Faturasız siparişler biriktikçe hem müşteriye hem mali müşavire açıklama yükü büyür. Order completed but no e-Archive invoice, or the integrator rejected it. A broken connection, missing buyer data or the wrong invoice type: tests and fixes. e-Archive Invoice Not Being Issued Home Services & Engagement Model Capacity & Infrastructure Agency Kit Crash Test (60s) Handover Audit tmai Diagnostic Catalog Salvageability Index Post-Mortem & RCA Triage Simulator SLA & Commitments Tech Matrix Mutual NDA Confidentiality and Engagement Agreement Damage Simulator Status Radar Codebase Health Rescue or Rebuild? Downtime Calculator Technical Glossary Our Story Emergency Support About Us Privacy Policy Orders complete, but e-Archive invoices are not created, are created incomplete, or are rejected by the integrator. The invoice drops at one link of the chain from the order to the integrator; the integrator's response and the order record together tell you which link. Urgency: High · legal obligation · Category: Orders & Payments Field Observations The customer says the invoice never arrived by email, or the accountant notices at month end that orders and invoices do not match. The order looks 'completed' on the site, while the integrator's panel has no invoice for it or shows it as 'rejected'. What you see on screen Integrator panel: no invoice · or 'rejected' The private integrator's panel — error codes and messages differ by integrator Observed System Error Signatures Integrator panel: no invoice record for the order number → A · Connection broken Application log: integrator request 401 or timeout → A · Connection broken Integrator response: rejected · buyer tax ID / national ID or address invalid → B · Integrator rejected it Buyer's tax ID is a registered e-Invoice user, invoice sent as e-Archive → C · Wrong invoice type The integrator issues the invoice and transmits it to the Turkish Revenue Administration; the site's job is to send the right data once and log the response. If the integrator's rejection is not logged, the problem stays invisible. Three Potential Root Causes & Differential Tests A · Connection broken The request from the site to the integrator never leaves or drops on the way: credentials changed, the access token expired, the integrator's address changed, or the request times out. The integrator's panel has no record at all for that order. Differential test: Does the integrator have a record for the order? Evidence: No record at the integrator, 401 in the app → A Resolution: Fix credentials, queue the requests Common anti-pattern fix: Orders without invoices are invoiced one by one by hand in the integrator's panel, but the connection is not fixed; the next day the same list forms again. B · Integrator rejected it The request reaches the integrator but is rejected because the invoice data is missing or wrong: the buyer's tax ID or national ID number, address, tax rate or amount fields. If the rejection is not logged, the site assumes the invoice was issued. Differential test: Is there a rejection in the response? Evidence: Rejection and error code in the response → B Resolution: Fix the data, send it once Common anti-pattern fix: The rejected invoice is resent with the same data; since the data is not fixed it is rejected again, or two invoices get created for the same order during the fix. C · Wrong invoice type According to the Turkish Revenue Administration, the e-Archive invoice is issued for sales to taxpayers not registered in the e-Invoice system and to non-taxpayers. If the buyer is registered in the e-Invoice system, the invoice must be issued as an e-Invoice. If the site sends an e-Archive invoice without checking whether a business buyer is registered, the invoice is issued as the wrong type or rejected by the integrator. Differential test: Is the buyer registered for e-Invoice? Evidence: Buyer registered for e-Invoice, e-Archive sent → C Resolution: Choose the type per buyer Common anti-pattern fix: The invoice type is left hard-coded and only the rejected orders are fixed by hand; every new order from a business buyer repeats the same case. Check it yourself in the first 10 minutes List the latest invoices in the integrator's panel and compare them with orders to find which orders have no invoice. For orders without invoices, look for the request sent to the integrator and the response in the application logs: no request means the connection, a rejection means the data. Look the error code in rejections up in the integrator's own documentation. For business buyers with a tax ID, check whether the buyer is on the Turkish Revenue Administration's list of registered e-Invoice users. Check whether the integrator user credentials or access key changed recently, or whether the contract or usage allowance ran out. When to hand it over Hand it over if the code that creates invoices has to change, if orders left without invoices must be invoiced in bulk, or if a decision about invoice type and tax fields is needed. Tax and regulatory decisions belong to the accountant; the technical team only fixes the connection. Who resolves it A backend engineer who knows the integration, together with the accountant. The engineer fixes the connection, the logging of rejections and the one-time resubmission of missing invoices; decisions about invoice type and tax fields belong to the accountant. Impact If Left Unresolved When invoices for goods sold are not issued on time, the problem stops being technical and becomes a legal obligation. As orders without invoices pile up, so does the explaining owed to customers and to the accountant.
